lines: was a vast underground passageway, different from the strange rooms that had stretched on and on.
!? Did we get out of the labyrinth...!?
Oh. Good, it seems I was right.
If I had been wrong, I had intended to think about it however many times, but it felt good to get it right on the first try.
If we've made it this far, the goal should be near. If we continue onward, we should be able to break out of the "Crossroads of Confusion."
Yes. You are just full of surprises today...
Oh, am I? But it's too early to rejoice. We still need to find Saburo andー
Suddenly, a bloodcurdling shriek echoed through the underground passage.
We stared down the passage. And thereー
There was a giant, monstrous spider with demonic miasma all over its bodyー
And on its back sat a girl in a school uniform, her eyes distorted into emptiness.
That's Saburo. The Onigumo Clan is known as a clan of Beast Art users who control giant spiders, but...
...But there is something wrong with her.
Even when she looked at me and Shonosuke, she gave no indication she recognized us. Ratherー
It definitely seems like she's being manipulated.
The giant spider that Saburo was riding roared and scratched the floor with its rigid limbs.
The spider was gathering its strength. It was ready to pounce on us at any moment.
Shonosuke eyes darkened ever so slightly as he asked me.
Did we have no choice but to kill the crazed Saburoーthat's what he was asking.
It will be fine. She's just been taken over by a Shadow.
Yes. Even without killing Saburo, we can expel the Shadow if we knock her unconscious. Butー
I observed the giant Oni-spider that was giving off a sinister aura.
Honestly, it's going to be far harder than killing her. Knocking Saburo out while she's being protected by the Oni-spider, I mean.
Shonosuke smiled with a look of relief and quickly moved forward.
ーThank you, Kotaro-sama. Leave this to us.
Following after him, Shishigami also drew her sword and moved forward.
The two sword-wielding Taimanin stood in the path of the charging Oni-spider as it roared.
